note: Guide pins by Full Clear. Positions are placed on Rockstar's official Leonida map from the sources listed; 'verified' becomes true once a community member confirms in game (Discord /submit).

pins.description: Military base in the southwest Leonida Keys, next to Southwind (official map squares L-2/L-3). Tanks and fighter jets are parked here.
pins.how: Expect a heavy police and army response the moment you trespass.

pins.description: Big airport west of Vice City (official map square H-5). Players report airliners like the 747 on the apron.
pins.how: Planes can be taken, but getting airborne without a wanted level is another story.

pins.description: A helipad on the water in the Leonida Keys, near Key Lento, with a helicopter you can take early.
pins.how: Walk onto the pad and get in. Exact spot not confirmed yet: help us pin it!

pins.location: Seaplanes at Southwind (Sherwin Boatworks / Chicki's Tiki Bar)
pins.description: A hangar on the water side of the boatworks and tiki bar lot in Southwind, next to Mile Zero. Seaplanes sit in or near the hangar and at the dock.
pins.how: Drive southwest from Key Lento on Route 1A, turn into the lot and take a seaplane. Nobody guards them.

pins.description: Gun shop in Southwind, the closest weapons store to the start of the game.
pins.how: Buy weapons and ammo here before heading north.

pins.description: An odd signpost hidden in a clump of trees on the sandy north side of the largest Permit Keys island.
pins.how: Photograph it with the phone camera (WAiNK) for the curiosities collection.

pins.description: The first safehouse. Home gym on the back deck, heavy bag in the shed below, cash stash under the bedroom floor.
pins.how: Train strength, stash cash and use the free house repairs. Exact spot approximate: confirm it on Discord!

pins.description: Roadside store with a big whale sculpture next to the highway in Key Lento; the sculpture stands just south of the store.
pins.how: Scan the sculpture with WAiNK. Pre-order owners collect the Vice City merch bonus here.

pins.description: Two wrecks lie on the sea floor off Key Lento's southeast coast, near a cluster of green islets. More wrecks are south and east of Key Lento.
pins.how: Dive with scuba gear and a metal detector, dig up artefacts and sell them to Kenton.

pins.description: The race track north of Ambrosia hosts repeatable demolition derbies. The figure-eight pays roughly double the oval.
pins.how: Rent a car at the track and win derbies for steady early cash.

pins.description: Shooting range in Manifest Canyon, just south of Father Scrumpy's apple orchard.
pins.how: Go for gold medals: they count toward 100%. The orchard next door is a WAiNK landmark.

pins.description: A statue of the cartoon character from earlier GTA games, to the right of the main entrance of the Y Hotel.
pins.how: Snap it with WAiNK for the sculptures collection.

pins.location: Dock Ring Ferris wheel (Downtown Vice City)
pins.description: Big waterfront Ferris wheel off Catalan Blvd in Downtown Vice City. Position approximate.
pins.how: Scan it with WAiNK for the landmarks collection.

pins.description: Lighthouse on the southern tip of Belpoint island, next to its small settlement, west of Capri.
pins.how: Scan it with WAiNK for the landmarks collection; good sunset photo spot.
